actual: When kline_minute_raw Go ingestion is interrupted by backend/TDX restart, per-symbol commits leave a partial current day while the durable job loses its live owner. The Go task registry is in-memory, restart reconciliation waits for the generic lease, and the next incremental run derives its range from global MAX(trade_time), so any partial row for today can be classified already-up-to-date and written as successful readiness without per-symbol 240/241-bar validation. Required fix: detect partial-day completeness, provide a today-only upsert repair path, prohibit DELETE/TRUNCATE and historical writes, validate in the existing DEV database first, and stop before production DML pending explicit authorization.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

expected: The current Asia/Shanghai trading date must be repairable by a full current-TDX A-share minute-source upsert only. Every source row must be normalized to the target date and written with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE; explicit empty source responses and source-native noncanonical session shapes remain auditable. The repair must fail closed on fetch errors, row-count parity mismatches, directory-outside rows, history changes, or any destructive SQL.
